column1: # Dividend-yield anchors for the `divYield` dial: the yield at fair value each anchor set carries
# (`Anchors.divYield`, %/yr) and the level band `dividend yield %` grades when the dial is on
# (`divYieldBand`: the window's ANNUAL means, min and max rounded outward to 0.1).  `DividendSuite` /
# `dividend_tests` re-derive both from this file; editing a row moves the shipped anchor.
# Conventions.  Shiller: D/P from the monthly S&P data (ie_data.xls, 2023.09 vintage: Dividend is
# the trailing 12-month total, Price the monthly level), in percent; the set's level is the monthly
# mean over the equity window 1954-2023, the century and full-history means are context.  Fund
# rows: the trailing-252-session distribution yield read off Yahoo's adjusted-close / close ratio
# (the ratio compounds every distribution), averaged by calendar year.  QQQ paid nothing before
# 2004 (annual yields 0.00 through 2003, 0.08 in 2004); a yield of an instrument that pays nothing
# is not a level, so the Nasdaq set's window opens 2005.  SPY is context for the S&P set: the ETF's
# yield since 1994 sits below the window mean because the payout level itself fell across the era
# (Shiller 1990-2023 monthly mean 2.02).  The model's yield varies only with fundamental/price;
# the record's varied with the payout level too, which the dial does not model.
# Measured 2026-09-02.
